mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, consumer confidence increases, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2%), a dovish monetary stance with controlled inflation leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A single-month increase in UNRATE above 0.5pp, signaling labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth rates are positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as increased retail sales signal strong consumer demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with RSAFS growth (t-test p > 0.05).
